name: Curse of Wandering
description: The curse raising corpses to roam the streets.

timeline.summary: Liliana releases the crocodiles, which swim away reanimated by the Curse of Wandering.
timeline.quote: The Curse of Wandering had taken hold.

pages_say.description: The curse that raises the dead on Amonkhet, which takes hold of the crocodiles after Liliana releases them.
The curse that animates the dead of Amonkhet, which Hapatra's poisons slow.
The curse that raises the dead as undead hunting the living.
The curse raising corpses to roam the streets.
